# Agent Plugins verification map

Read this index before driving Pi. Start with isolated global configuration, synthetic plugin contents, and no real marketplace enabled. Every run uses its own agent directory and workspace. Follow the [shared driver and evidence contract](../../verification/README.md).

- [Resources](resources.md): direct skills, Pi prompts, reload, and trusted project sources. The baseline verifies only global direct discovery.
- [Marketplaces](marketplaces.md): local add, disabled defaults, toggling, cancellation, refresh, and removal. GitHub sources need separate network approval.
- [MCP and hooks](mcp-hooks.md): native deferred tools, subprocess environment, trust, and hook effects.

Record feature and entry point with each artifact. A missing native MCP connection or unavailable GitHub clone is a failed precondition, not a pass via direct loading. Never mark skipped entry points verified. Creation-time runtime proof is blocked, so all entries remain unverified until executed.
